The materials in this repo contain exercises intended to be done by students. The exercises contain git and other shell commands. We want to make sure the relevant commands work, and are consistent with each other and the exercise text.

Walk through the requested exercises, and perform the relevant commands to see if they work.

Commit hashes mentioned in the exercises may be fictional examples; do not worry about mismatches there.

**DO EVERYTHING LOCALLY; DO NOT EVER PERFORM A GITHUB ACTION**

You can simulate 'git pushes' to github by instead creating local clones/remotes.

Only work in designated sandbox folders, in which you may clone/create test repos (assume /tmp).

Only check if the current commands in the exercises work; DO NOT ADD MORE EXERCISES OR COMMANDS.

**DO NOT EVERY CHANGE ANYTING IN THIS REPO WITHOUT FIRST ASKING A HUMAN**. First report findings in a human-friendly way: are there any broken exercises, what would be necessary to fix?
